subject: 1.2 GIGAzillion Bytes BIG!
author: ZombieTron
body:
Just to remind everybody, once you download the latest update ALL of the previous updates can be deleted from your hard drive as they are all included in the new download on Xbox 360.

However, do not delete all of the premium purchases as you would then have to download those again!

I am downloading the update now, will have to download it for Xandu too... will take ages!! 🕐
